intro: Resource management capability framework: materials, owned equipment and labor for engineering projects, organized as Strategic Control - Business Execution - Integrated Support, across four tiers (Group HQ - Subsidiary - Branch - Project Dept.).
Business execution follows five stages: Demand Planning - Sourcing & Contracting - Receipt & Mobilization - Site Operation - Settlement & Exit.
note: Note | Strategic control = HQ governance of resources; business execution = end-to-end resource value chain on projects; integrated support = services from other functions. L2 names are verb-object phrases; L3 components are listed in the inventory workbook.

b2.note: Note | Each L2 capability is broken into L3 business components that pass four tests (single responsibility / independently operable / loosely coupled / enterprise-governed); rules, norms and standards are attributes, not components. Cross-domain shared components will be identified after all domains are mapped.

b4.note: Columns = capability domains (aligned with B1) | grey bars = L2 groups | cells = business objects (real form/ledger names); details in the inventory workbook

rows.name:
Material Supply
(demand to paid)
rows.trigger:
Trigger: project material requirement plan
Delivers: inspected materials on site, settled supplier accounts
rows.stages: Demand Planning → Sourcing & Contracting → Receipt & Mobilization → Site Operation → Settlement & Exit
rows.value: Right material, right time, at benchmark price; consumption held within norms; no unsettled liabilities

rows.name:
Owned Equipment
(plan to retirement)
rows.trigger:
Trigger: equipment deployment plan
Delivers: equipment working on site, internal lease settled, asset returned or retired
rows.stages: Demand Planning → Sourcing & Contracting → Receipt & Mobilization → Site Operation → Settlement & Exit
rows.value: High fleet utilization across projects, safe certified operation, lowest lifecycle cost

rows.name:
Labor Services
(plan to wages paid)
rows.trigger:
Trigger: labor deployment plan
Delivers: registered, trained workforce; wages paid in full and on time
rows.stages: Demand Planning → Sourcing & Contracting → Receipt & Mobilization → Site Operation → Settlement & Exit
rows.value: Compliant real-name workforce, zero wage arrears, labor cost settled against measured work

overview.note: Note | A value stream qualifies when it (1) runs end to end from a clear trigger to a clear deliverable, (2) has an identifiable customer, and (3) crosses organization tiers and at least two stages. Streams are cut by resource type because each has its own trigger, customer outcome and settlement logic.

pages.title: From Demand to Paid Supplier
pages.subtitle: Material Supply
pages.chain: Demand Planning → Sourcing & Contracting → Receipt & Mobilization → Site Operation → Settlement & Exit
pages.legend: Internal service stream: triggered by project material demand, ends with supplier paid; settlement results feed supplier credit

pages.subtitle: Owned Equipment
pages.chain: Demand Planning → Sourcing & Contracting → Receipt & Mobilization → Site Operation → Settlement & Exit

pages.title: From Labor Plan to Wages Paid
pages.subtitle: Labor Services
